justification: Collins is on a bye - no game, zero on the board - and I already lived through this exact nightmare in Week 5, bye-week receiver, lowest score in the league, my name in the column. Not doing it twice. So DJ Moore comes in at WR1 even though he's Questionable and even though he's the same guy I benched in Week 6 for Worthy - I don't trust that tag, feels like exactly what they want me to think is fine, but a maybe-12 beats a guaranteed zero from a man who isn't even dressed. Everything else stays put on the numbers, not the gut: Geno over Mayfield and Herbert because a 17-point gap isn't something I need to overthink into a mistake, Kyren and White hold the backfield, London and Worthy round out the receivers, Kraft was already locked in from Thursday so there's nothing to agonize over there, Gay and the Titans D are what they are. I don't feel good about any of it. I never do. At least nobody's writing a bagel column about me this week.
forum_post: Harry, pal, real nice that the kicker's finally working out for ya - must be something, having a guy hand you the answer. Nobody's handing me anything over here, I'm out here benching bye weeks and un-burning myself in real time, by myself. Five-and-two isn't luck, it's scar tissue. See you Sunday - try to remember my guys' names when they're running past yours.
